scope: Acceptance requirements and executable equality/absence assertion specifications. F1 checks document consistency and assertion sensitivity only; observed service facts must be produced by F3/J1/E1-E5.

observationProtocol.pointers: RFC6901 paths into task-local normalized evidence, not new wire fields.
observationProtocol.equals: Deep equality, preserving JSON strings and arrays. Quantity/version/journal strings must never pass through Number.
observationProtocol.absent: The pointed field does not exist. Null and empty strings are not absence.
observationProtocol.measurement: Measure normalized booleans/counts from retained raw requests, typed responses and actual owner state/journal facts. Never copy expected facts into runtime observations. Every observation records the supplying service/container/source identity, clock instant, evidence path and extraction procedure. Missing observations fail equality; absence assertions require a captured parent record.
observationProtocol.schemaGate: Validate each raw request/response against its frozen operation schema before relational checks. Schema validity does not prove permissions, signature, calendar resolution, idempotency or commit.
observationProtocol.execution: All runtime cases require real Auth/Gateway/Warehouse/Serving/Feedback. Synthetic clocks, delivery sinks and fault infrastructure are permitted; no business or Auth decision doubles at J1/E.
